name: Welcome Modal UI
description: Startup workspace picker modal with branding, recent workspaces list, Open Workspace and Close buttons.

dom.root: .modal-overlay (position: fixed, display: flex/none, inset: 0, background: var(--scrim), align-items: center, justify-content: center, z-index: 10000)

elements.welcome-modal: .welcome-modal (role=dialog, aria-modal=true, background: var(--surface), border: 1px dashed var(--border), border-radius: 8px, padding: 32px, min-width: 420px, max-width: 500px)
elements.welcome-name: .welcome-name (font: 24px Space Mono, font-weight: 700, color: var(--primary), letter-spacing: 4px, id=welcome-title, aria-labelledby target)
elements.welcome-sub: .welcome-sub (font-size: 12px, color: var(--tertiary), margin-top: 4px, text: 'Select a workspace')
elements.welcome-recent: .welcome-recent (id=welcome-recent, display: block/none based on recent items)
elements.welcome-recent-item: .welcome-recent-item (display: flex, justify-content: space-between, padding: 6px 8px, cursor: pointer, border-radius: 4px, hover bg: var(--panel))
elements.welcome-recent-item-path: .welcome-recent-item-path (font-size: 12px, color: var(--primary), overflow: hidden, text-overflow: ellipsis, white-space: nowrap); .welcome-recent-item-missing adds opacity:0.4
elements.welcome-recent-item-remove: button.welcome-recent-item-remove (text: ×, aria-label: 'Remove {path} from recent', background: none, border: none, cursor: pointer, color: var(--tertiary))

interactions.name: open_workspace
interactions.action: IPC workspace:select (native directory picker) → If path selected, resolve promise with path
interactions.result: Promise resolves with workspace path string

interactions.name: select_recent
interactions.action: Validate path exists via fs:readDir → If exists, resolve promise with path
interactions.result: Promise resolves with recent workspace path

interactions.name: remove_recent
interactions.action: IPC workspace:removeRecent → Remove item from DOM → If no items remain, hide container and separator

interactions.name: close
interactions.action: Resolve promise with null → Hide overlay → Remove Escape listener

states.open: Overlay display:flex, recent list populated async from IPC workspace:getRecent. Missing paths show as faded (welcome-recent-item-missing). No recent items: container + separator hidden.
states.closed: Overlay display:none, Escape listener removed, promise resolved

props.open: () => Promise<string | null> — shows modal, load recents, returns path or null
